name: Hugging Face
purpose: Hugging Face addresses the challenge of democratizing AI by providing easy access to state-of-the-art machine learning models and tools. It simplifies the development, sharing, and deployment of AI systems, enabling researchers and developers to build advanced AI applications efficiently without needing extensive computational resources or deep technical knowledge.
keyCapabilities: Hosting and sharing pre-trained models and datasets.
Distributed training and mixed-precision support for PyTorch.
Building and sharing interactive ML demos (Spaces).

researchPapers.title: Anatomy of a Machine Learning Ecosystem: 2 Million Models on Hugging Face
researchPapers.authors: Benjamin Laufer, Hamidah Oderinwale, Jon Kleinberg

researchPapers.title: What do we know about Hugging Face? A systematic literature review and quantitative validation of qualitative claims
